name: trellis-identity-message-consistency
title: Trellis identity reporting: one diagnosis across every site
description: Reporting half split out of 08-08-developer-identity-not-in-worktrees on 2026-08-17. Eight sites report an unresolved developer identity in four media (stderr prose, a JSON error/hint object parsed by an upstream regression test, lines inside two returned context documents, and a raised ValueError); they disagree about the leading diagnosis, four carry no hint at all, and none can distinguish an unusable identity file from an absent one. Needs one shared diagnosis with medium-appropriate rendering, plus deletion of add_session.py's dead branch. Vendored Trellis code, so upstream-handoff-first: the patch, the staged tests, and the register entry are executable in this repository now; only the uptake waits on a Trellis release and a vendored refresh.
creator: sdelmas
